output.advice: Redraw so the bird reads at a glance. Enlarge the silhouette to fill more of the frame and centre it. Make the head and neck distinct: put star 44248 at the crown just under the beak, with a clear beak point up-right, and keep the neck tapering down into the body. Place star 44700 at the centre of the chest where the two wings meet, slightly below the neck base. Keep the wingtips 47029 (upper) and 46952 (lower) on the outermost points of the spread wings. Make the body narrow toward the rear so star 45688 sits at the rump and tail root. Put star 45860 at the tip of a clearly shaped tail. Move the labels off the gold lines and away from the outline so none overlap. Make the bird's pose unambiguous, for example with the wings clearly raised or folded, so a viewer can name it without the title.
